citations.claim: energy still below bound just before violation while both bodies fall
first violating step: energy exceeds E0+10%+5J bound with no controller work

explanation: Two e=1 bodies stacked above floor fall under g=30. At step 6 the lower body contacts the floor while also in contact with the upper body. Sequential impulse + positional correction for the two contacts in the same step injects net energy: lower body reverses from vy~-5 to vy~+7.6 and upper to +6.45, raising total mechanical energy from ~91.5J to ~112.8J vs allowed 107.3J with zero controller work.
vision_note: Two small circles fall together vertically, stacked, toward the bottom wall across steps 3 to 5. In step 6 the lower circle makes contact with the floor while still touching the upper circle.
